commands.command: Diagnosed and fixed 3 genuine test/product defects surfaced by running the repaired suite: (1) tests/test_admission.py hardcoded work/active/050-.../work-item.json, stale after WI050's legitimate active->deferred transition; (2) tests/test_guard_authority.py's isolated self-test exercised sys.executable (this repo's own .venv interpreter) against a security check that deliberately rejects any .venv-sourced interpreter for protected-guard installation, which can never pass for a project dev-venv regardless of correctness; (3) repopact/legacy_validate.py's Python compatibility comparator treated every Problem (including 'warning'-severity ones) as blocking, unlike validate_repo.py's own main(), causing two intentionally-warning-only assurance-mapping conformance fixtures to be misreported as rejected; (4) repopact/validate_repo.py's assurance overclaiming heuristic did substring-only matching with no negation awareness, flagging explicit disclaimers ('does not assert X is certified') as if they were the claim itself
commands.summary: (1)/(2) fixed by adding repopact.dev_fixtures.pin_work_item_status(root, id, status) and using it (or resolving sys._base_executable instead of sys.executable) in the affected test setUp methods -- no product security invariant was weakened. (3) fixed by making legacy_validate.main() filter through validate_repo.blocking_problems(), matching the canonical validator's own behavior. (4) fixed by adding a negation-window check (_has_unnegated_strong_claim) before flagging a strong-claim phrase. python -m repopact.run_conformance (both --legacy-python and canonical Rust) now reports 35/35 comparator cases and 8/8 WI050 vectors passed, up from 33/35 before the negation/severity fixes.

373 tests, 2 failures, 0 errors, 3 skipped (down from the pre-remediation baseline of 369 tests / 20 failures / 24 errors / 2 skipped). The 2 remaining failures (test_protected_substrate.ProtectedSubstrateTests.test_status_reports_backend_owned_health and test_windows_backend_is_not_covered_before_install) are a genuine host-state boundary, not a product or test defect: this specific machine carries a real native RepoPact guard installation at C:\ProgramData\RepoPact\Guard, dated 2026-09-16 20:10, which is legitimate evidence from prior WI050 Windows native-destructive-proof work (see evidence/runs/20260916-050-windows-native-destructive-proof.json). These fixture-based unit tests assume a clean-slate host with no guard installed; the operator explicitly declined to uninstall real host security state to force these tests green. Left untouched and reported as a boundary rather than weakened.
617 passed, 0 failed, 10 ignored (explicit #[ignore]d live-network tests, unchanged) across all 47 test binaries in the workspace.
